newsitem.title: USA: Cytogen ends shelf registration offering.
newsitem.headline: Cytogen ends shelf registration offering.

text.p: Cytogen Corp said on Friday that it completed the last financing under its shelf registration statement on Form S-3 filed March 1996.

Pursuant to a stock purchase agreement executed in August 1996, Cytogen said, it sold 776,791 shares of common stock to a European institutional investor for $5.10 per share for a total of about $4 million.
Cytogen said it has terminated the offering of shares of common stock described in the shelf registration and has filed an amendment to remove from registration the remaining unsold shares.

"We believe that Cytogen's current cash position of approximately $39 million is sufficient to support the Company's business over the next several quarters," said T. Jerome Madison, Cytogen vice president and chief financial officer.

Cytogen is a biopharmaceutical company engaged in the development, manufacturing and commercialization of products for the targeted delivery of diagnostics and therapeutic substances directly to disease sites.
